text:
ajay: Short RFC follow-up: we must agree the minimal telemetry contract so ops/eval can detect quality drift across FP8/INT8/4-bit paths. What do we emit at 100% vs sampled?

katie: Ops wants low-cardinality 100% fields: precision_profile_id, model@version, degradation_score (aggregate), mean_token_confidence, batching_latency_ms, gpu_mem_pct, prompt_fp (hashed).

mike: Also kv_cache_hits and worker_queue_ms. Add a cheap mismatch proxy: top1_token_mismatch_rate against a cached shadow for quick alerts.

sophia: Per-layer arrays are costly. Proposal: sample N% (configurable) for full per_layer_{mean_abs,max_abs}. All requests include mean_abs_delta and top_k_mismatch_rate. Include sample_rate when we emit per-layer to reconstruct bias.

lina: From eval: we need precision_profile_label (human) + immutable precision_profile_id (GUID) so we can trace regressions. Also provide prompt_fp and prompt_present boolean so we can avoid logging prompt text.

ajay: Agreed. Minimal schema will be a flat map of strings/numbers in snake_case. We'll publish a small example in the RFC appendix.

katie: Control-plane should own rollouts/canaries. Runtime must implement a small emergency override when control-plane unreachable: simple rules with hysteresis to avoid flapping. Runtime logs every override with reason_code and metric snapshot for audits.

sophia: Runtime override heuristic: only downgrade precision when infra pressure AND quality-safe signal are both met. Pseudocode: if (latency>X OR mem>Y) AND degradation_score<Z -> emergency_fallback (apply fallback_profile) start hysteresis_timer. Revert when control_plane_reachable or quality_recovery for T minutes.

mike: Canary: start 0.5% traffic, shadow-sample high-fidelity per-layer for all canary requests. Auto rollback if median degradation_score > 0.04 for 5min or top_k_mismatch_rate spikes > 0.02. Human approval required above 5% traffic. Also gate on tokens_saved_pct and cost_delta_usd so we can trade cost vs quality.

ajay: Telemetry retention: default 30d, enterprise can request 90d after compliance review. Runtime must hash prompt fingerprints and never emit raw prompt.

quant-bot: "RFC follow-up recorded: telemetry schema + hybrid runtime override FSM + canary gates. Action items: @sophia PR runtime FSM, @ajay publish schema, @mike draft canary playbook, @katie update retention & audit policy." :white_check_mark:

sophia: I'll open the PR today with the FSM sketch and minimal schema. If folks agree on the fields above I'll update the RFC appendix and we can instrument a canary tomorrow.

katie: moving to RFC update. Thanks all.
